headline: The listing says 2108 Orange. A Labor Day post still said 2053.
summary: This is a real family homestead at 2108 Orange Avenue in Ramona. The Beene family already shows up in the story. Facebook this week prints cbeene32@gmail.com and (760) 814-4836. The live shop is lilpatchofheaven.org, a cart with this month's blog. Facebook, the chamber, and the directories still print every day 8 to 8. A Labor Day post this month still said we are at 2053 Orange Ave, open from 8 to 8. Facebook still lists beenefamilyfarm, a ThriveCart cart, and cbeene32.wixsite.com/lilpatchofheaven. That Wix page is a 404 this week. A neighbor with an honor-system run can pull up to the wrong Orange Avenue number, or land on a leftover Wix door that is gone.
